item.title: Safdie Bit Players Follow Up Unreleased 'Uncut Gems' Companion Album With Unreleased Odessa A'zion Companion Album
item.description: Mitchell Wenig and his brother Stewart briefly appeared as brothers in the Safdie brothers’ 2019 smash Uncut Gems. item.description: The Swedish pop-R&B singer and Sub Pop signee Waterbaby dropped two promising singles on us in 2025, “Amiss” and “Beck n Call.” Today she’s revealed that those songs are part of Memory Be A Blade, her new album dropping in March.
